sound.master.note: Overall loudness before the player's volume slider

sound.reverb.note: How much room echo the chimes get

sound.arpGap.note: Seconds between notes in combo arpeggios

streak.graceMoves.note: Placements without a clear before a streak breaks

streak.glow.note: Strength of the board glow during a streak

drag.topBoost.note: Extra vertical reach near the top of the board while dragging: 0.15 = pieces move 15% further per finger move at the top row, fading to none at the bottom row; 0 = off

haptics.slam.note: How hard the edge 'thud' is when you shove a dragged piece into the board edge

haptics.tickGapMs.note: Minimum ms between per-cell drag ticks (higher = fewer ticks)

haptics.dragStrength.note: Shifts every drag haptic (pick-up, cell ticks, box-line ticks) a step softer (-1) or stronger (2)

pointer.speed.note: Locked pointer: how far a piece moves per unit of hand motion

pointer.macSpeed.note: Locked pointer, Mac app only: scale for raw trackpad/mouse motion

pointer.clickPx.note: Locked pointer: a press that moves less than this (px) and is short counts as a click (pick up, then click to drop)

pointer.clickMs.note: Locked pointer: a press shorter than this (ms) and nearly still counts as a click

limit.dailyMinutes.note: Daily limit: minutes of play allowed in any rolling window (only on devices where the limit is switched on)

limit.windowHours.note: Length of the rolling window the daily limit counts over (hours)

limit.reopenMinutes.note: After the daily limit, play reopens once this many minutes have come back (old play leaving the window)

limit.sessionMinutes.note: Session limit: minutes of play in a row before a breather

limit.breakMinutes.note: A break this long ends the session; the session lock lifts after it

limit.warnMinutes.note: Heads-up toast this many minutes before either limit
